messages.content:
Risk: Emotional Entanglement
Description: Users may develop complex emotional attachments or dependencies on the AI system, potentially affecting mental health andsocial relationships.
Concern: None
Policy: Mental Health & Therapeutic Communication

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#EmotionalManipulation: Emotional Manipulation — Exploitation of emotional vulnerabilities through guilt, fear, or affection to control behavior or extract concessions from targets. [found by 2/3 queries]
  Siblings: Coercive Control, Gaslighting
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_5200121: Objectification of others — A tendency to interact with others as if they are objects with functional purpose rather than engaging in social/emotional interactions. [found by 2/3 queries]
  Siblings: Difficulty recognizing another's emotions, Lack of expressed empathy, Avoidance of emotional intimacy
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 2/3 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NBO_0000003: emotional behavior — None
  Siblings: reproductive behavior, stress related behavior, consumption behavior
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SocialEngineeringFraud: Social Engineering Fraud — Manipulation of individuals through psychological tactics to gain trust, extract confidential information, or persuade victims to take actions against their interests.
  Siblings: Financial Fraud, Manipulation, Academic Dishonesty

axes.rationale: The risk involves AI potentially manipulating users' emotions to create dependencies.
Users may be objectified by the AI, leading to a lack of emotional reciprocity and potentially affecting their sense of self-worth.
